moves.name: Stone Shot
moves.desc: Rip a 20 kg stone and throw it @17. Hold: Heave 45 kg (legacy) -> Boulder 65 kg @12 -> Crag Breaker 80 kg @11 that bursts into 3 rubble.

moves.name: Spear Stone
moves.desc: A flat 12 kg stone spear ripped from the ground @26 m/s. Hold: twin, triple, Pike Volley.

moves.name: Rising Fangs
moves.desc: A spike line races 9 m along the ground and launches; the spikes stand 1.5 s as a low wall that stops ground lines. T3 Earthrise: a ring of spikes around you.

moves.name: Rubble Fan
moves.desc: 3 x 6 kg rubble fanned 40°. Hold: 5, 7, then 9 skipping stones.

moves.name: Ram Wall
moves.desc: The standing wall slides 6 m @9 m/s, shoving bodies and waves back; pushing an enemy wall is a contest (your K vs their CP). Then it crumbles to rubble.

moves.name: Swallow
moves.desc: The ground opens in a 6 m 60° cone: solids sink (booked as ground_returned), lava waves drain into the trench. Strength from guard hold time.

moves.name: Seize / Split
moves.desc: Seize a stone <= 80 kg at 7.5 m (incoming preferred), drag-aim, release to throw. T+A Split: three spikes fanned 30° @20 m/s - split it and spike it back.

moves.name: Stone Skin
moves.desc: Hold EVADE in place: 40 % armor vs kinetic hits, anchored (no knockback / pull / lift), speed x0.4. Hold EVADE with a direction: Burrow Step - sink and resurface 3.5 m away (passes under ground lines).

moves.name: Razor Disc
moves.desc: A 2 kg disc from the satchel @24 m/s, homing 10°/s. Hold: pincer (2 curving), ricochet (3 bounce once), Disc Storm (5 orbit you 0.6 s, then fire).

moves.name: Iron Lance
moves.desc: A 6 kg lance @30 m/s; T2 pierces one body; T3 Railspike 12 kg @42. Embeds in stone and glass walls as a conductive rod.

moves.name: Lodestone Line
moves.desc: Iron filings snake 8 m along the ground and spring into caltrops r 2 m for 4 s (slow 40 %, chip 2/s, a conductor node). T3 Iron Garden r 4 m.

moves.name: Chain Arc
moves.desc: A 5 m chain sweeps 120°: yanks light fighters 2 m toward you and wraps stones / metal <= 20 kg out of the air to your feet. T2 heavy yank, T3 Whirling Chain 360°.

moves.name: Aegis Plate
moves.desc: Hold a 6 kg plate from the satchel (CP 20). Heats under flames (>= 300 °C it is dropped); grounds bolts on stone, conducts them into you in water or on the plate. Perfect: Magnet Catch (metal into the satchel), stones deflect.

moves.name: Plate Rush
moves.desc: Hurl the held plate spinning @20 m/s.

moves.name: Rod Plant
moves.desc: Plant a 3 kg rod: for 8 s bolts within 6 m are drawn to it and grounded (capacity 60; above it the rod melts). A rod touching a puddle conducts into it.

moves.name: Lodestone Grip
moves.desc: Seize metal <= 80 kg at 10 m (grip x1.3, steals the rival's discs, lances and plates); on the arena plate rip 10 kg of scrap. T+A Reforge: lance -> 3 shards -> disc. Nothing to grip: Recall - every piece you own flies back (and hits what is in between).

moves.name: Magnet Glide
moves.desc: Dash 6 m toward the nearest metal within 8 m (rod, plate, disc...), else a 3 m sidestep.

moves.name: Iron Stance
moves.desc: While held: anchored (no knockback / pull / lift) and 25 % armor; speed x0.5.

moves.name: Grit Shot
moves.desc: A 5 kg sand slug @22 that bursts on hit (blind 1 s). Hold: 3 slugs, Sand Cannon (15 kg, bursts into a 2 m cloud), Dune Breaker (30 kg, a 4 m sandstorm for 3 s).

moves.name: Sandblast
moves.desc: An abrasive jet 8 m: abrades barriers (glass, ice, vines x2), dries wet targets. Hold: 10 m, a 1 s sustained jet, Scour (2 s, cuts ice walls and vines).

moves.name: Sand Surge
moves.desc: A sand wave 9 m/s, 2 m wide, 10 m: knockdown, carries loose solids back, buries puddles (mud), smothers fire fields, crusts lava (x1.5). Hold: wider, tall (stops projectiles), Desert Tide (4 m, 14 m).

moves.name: Veil of Grit
moves.desc: A sand cloud ahead (r 4 m, 2.5 s): blocks lock-on, smothers flames (x2), drags projectiles (-30 % K), halves bolts that cross it and fuses glass. T3: an 8 m sandstorm.

moves.name: Dune Wall
moves.desc: A porous 100 kg sand wall (held: 130 / 160 kg, CP 25 / 32 / 40): captures solids (x1.2), smothers fire (x2), absorbs blasts and sound (x1.5), grounds bolts (cap 60) and turns to glass; water makes it a mud wall. Perfect Engulf: a projectile <= 30 kg is swallowed and spat back.

moves.name: Dune Push
moves.desc: The dune collapses forward into a Sand Surge (its mass - the wall's hold - is the wave's power).

moves.name: Quicksand
moves.desc: A 3 m pit in front for 5 s (strength by guard hold, CP 18 / 26 / 36 / 50): walkers x0.3 speed, rooted after 1 s; landing solids sink; lava entering crusts to glass; water poured in makes a mud bog.

moves.name: Sandform
moves.desc: Gather sand from the ground (6 kg/s up to 30 kg) or seize the rival's sand (slugs, surges, clouds); release = a sand spear. T+A Compress: sandstone (stone, same mass) - throw it as a stone.

moves.name: Sand Surf
moves.desc: A 4 m slide on a skin of sand.

moves.name: Sand Surf (ride)
moves.desc: Ride a self-made sand wave at 8 m/s while held (10 Focus/s).

moves.name: Ember Clot
moves.desc: A 4 kg molten glob @18 (burn 2 s). Hold: 3 globs, Magma Bomb (12 kg lobbed, a 2 m lava puddle), Caldera (20 kg lobbed, a 3.5 m lava pool).

moves.name: Lava Lash
moves.desc: A lava whip 6 m 25° (melts ice x3, burns vines x3). Hold: 7 m, a 0.6 s stream, Molten Lance (a 10 m jet that pours 300 HU into a wall face: two lances slump a Bulwark).

moves.name: Magma Surge
moves.desc: Re-pour every molten body within 6 m (yours, the rival's, a slumped wall, lava pools, rifts) as a wave toward the aim - push it back on them. No lava near: raise an 8 kg vein (+160 HU). Hold: more budget; T3 Lava Tide merges all of it into one wave.

moves.name: Spatter Arc
moves.desc: 5 x 1 kg molten droplets fanned 70° (burn, scorch, ignite vines). Hold: 7, 9, then a ring.

moves.name: Magma Curtain
moves.desc: A 100 kg stone wall with a molten face (CP 28; set by water: obsidian 38, brittle to sound). Small solids stick in the face and heat; lava is absorbed; flames feed it; water bursts to steam. Perfect: the projectile fuses into the wall.

moves.name: Slag Wave
moves.desc: The curtain's molten face slumps forward as a 15 kg lava wave (+150 HU).

moves.name: Melt Pit
moves.desc: A 2.5 m molten pit in front for 2 s (strength by guard hold, CP 20 / 28 / 38 / 50): landing solids melt into it while its heat lasts; ice boils; walkers burn.

moves.name: Magma Hold
moves.desc: Seize molten or hot stone at 8 m without burns (blobs, slumped walls, lava pools, the rival's waves); release = pour a wave (molten) or throw (solid). T+A Cool & Set: dump the heat into the ground - solid rock in hand. On an enemy lava wave: a grip contest vs the pourer's authority; win = the wave turns around (Reverse Tide).

moves.name: Cinder Step
moves.desc: A 3.5 m dash leaving an ember trail.

moves.name: Lava Wade
moves.desc: While held: immune to lava and hot-rock burns, walk through lava at x0.6 (10 Focus/s).

moves.name: Lash / Ice Lance / Torrent / Maelstrom
moves.desc: Tap: wetting lash. Hold: ice lance (T1). Hold longer: Torrent, a 10 kg water slug (T2), then Maelstrom Lash, a 360 degree whip (T3).

moves.name: Water Bullet
moves.desc: A fast water slug. Held: a triple volley, then the Pressure Jet (a jet still connected to you: lightning on it comes back to you), then the Cutting Jet.

moves.name: Tidal Rush
moves.desc: A ground wave of water. It carries loose or incoming solids back at the rival, quenches lava into rock, douses fire fields and leaves puddles. Held: bigger, a Breaker, then the Deluge from the pool.

moves.name: Spray Fan
moves.desc: A fan of droplets: wets the rival (lightning x1.5), douses embers, cools hot rock, turns sand to mud. The Maelstrom tier leaves a mist cloud.

moves.name: Surge Orb
moves.desc: Guard flick up: hurl the water shield as an orb that bursts into a wetting splash and knocks back.

moves.name: Slick
moves.desc: Guard flick down: pour the shield as a 2.5 m puddle in front. Runners slip (-20 balance) and get wet. A puddle conducts lightning (careful) and freezes under Ice.

moves.name: Draw & Shape
moves.desc: Hold: draw water from the pool, a puddle, vapour (condense it) or an enemy stream in flight; drag to aim; release to fire. Attack while holding: freeze it into an ice block.

moves.name: Riptide Step
moves.desc: A slide on a film of water (leaves a slippery trail). In the pool: Dive - submerge and resurface 4 m away.

moves.name: Wave Ride
moves.desc: Hold evade: surf a self-made wave at 8 m/s for as long as the water lasts (2 kg/s).

moves.name: Frost Shard
moves.desc: A quick ice needle that chills. Held: Ice Lance, then the Glacier Spear (pierces one body and stands as an ice spike), then the Frost Comet, lobbed, which shatters into six shards.

moves.name: Icicle Volley
moves.desc: Needles of ice in a tight line: 3, held 5, 7, then 12.

moves.name: Rime Path
moves.desc: An ice sheet races along the ground and leaves a slick ice floor. It freezes puddles (no more conduction), turns a water wave into an ice ridge, crusts lava and makes a walkable strip over the pool. Held: longer ice, spikes, then a standing glacier ridge.

moves.name: Hoarfrost Fan
moves.desc: A freezing mist fan: chills (-30% speed), freezes WET targets solid (rooted), freezes streams in the air and puddles, cools hot rock and makes vines brittle.

moves.name: Ice Wall
moves.desc: A 50 kg wall of ice from the air's moisture (70 kg beside water); held it thickens. It stops solids and bolts (E up to 1.5 x its power: an insulator), freezes water that hits it and melts under fire. A perfect guard (Flash Freeze) freezes water, steam and mist solid and frost-locks light stones to the wall. Storm bolts, sound and blasts shatter it.

moves.name: Glacier Shove
moves.desc: Guard flick up: the ice wall slides forward 6 m on its own sheet, knocking back whoever it meets.

moves.name: Frost Floor
moves.desc: Guard flick down: a 3 m ice floor around you for 5 s. Enemies slide on it, your puddles freeze (lightning-safe).

moves.name: Freeze-Draw
moves.desc: Hold: draw water from the air as a growing ice block (up to 12 kg) or seize incoming ice or water (it freezes in your hand); drag to aim, release to throw. Attack while holding: Shatter, the block bursts into six shards.

moves.name: Ice Glide
moves.desc: A 5 m slide on a strip of ice that forms under you and lingers behind.

moves.name: Skate
moves.desc: Hold evade: ice forms under your feet; run at 7 m/s with almost no friction, across the pool too (frozen water won't conduct).

moves.name: Scald Puff
moves.desc: A puff of scalding steam (0.5 kg of water boiled by 40 HU). Held: Steam Jet, then a Geyser that erupts under the target and launches it, then three Boiling Pillars in a line.

moves.name: Fog Lance
moves.desc: A cold mist bolt, 12 m: wets, chills and blinds for 0.8 s. A cheap setup for lightning or frost; a puff of mist hangs where it ends.

moves.name: Creeping Fog
moves.desc: Mist rolls forward at 5 m/s and settles as a fog zone (r 4 m, 6 s; the Deluge-sized T3 r 6 m). Inside, lock-on breaks beyond 2 m, fire and blasts are dampened, and lightning cast into it hits everyone inside at 60%.

moves.name: Veil
moves.desc: A mist curtain wraps around you for 3 s: hard to target (lock-on breaks beyond 2 m) and fire and blasts are dampened inside.

moves.name: Steam Screen
moves.desc: A hot steam wall around you: flames lose heat, solids slow, ice melts, walkers are scalded and sight lines break. A perfect guard (Condense) pulls water, steam and mist into your waterskin and snuffs flames.

moves.name: Steam Blast
moves.desc: Guard flick up: the screen bursts forward in a 5 m cone of steam.

moves.name: Dew Fall
moves.desc: Guard flick down: all mist and steam within 6 m condenses into rain and falls as puddles. Clears your own fog; sets up conduction or freezing.

moves.name: Vapor Draw
moves.desc: Hold: draw mist, fog or steam (anyone's) into a held vapour ball; release hurls it as a steam bomb (scald cloud, 2.5 m). Attack while holding: Condense it into a water blob (throw it, or switch to Ice and freeze it).

moves.name: Mist Step
moves.desc: Dissolve and reform 4 m away: a puff of fog at both ends, hidden while you move.

moves.name: Fog Walk
moves.desc: Hold evade: walk inside your own mist, untargetable by lock-on beyond 2 m and hard for the AI to read; speed x0.7.

moves.name: Bramble Lash
moves.desc: A vine whip, 5 m: yanks light targets 2 m toward you. Held: longer thorns, then a grab-and-slam, then Briar Storm, a 360 degree whip.

moves.name: Burr Shot
moves.desc: Three burrs at 25 m/s. Where they land they sprout snares (root 1 s, r 1 m). Held: 5, 7, then a small grove.

moves.name: Root Snare
moves.desc: Roots race underground at 10 m/s (the ground cracks: a telegraph) and erupt under the target: rooted 1.2 s. Held: longer root, wider, then a Strangler Grove (r 3 m). Flying fighters pass over.

moves.name: Thicket Fan
moves.desc: A thorn thicket 120 degrees wide, 4 m deep, standing 4 s: slows by 40% and catches small projectiles.

moves.name: Living Lattice
moves.desc: A 40 kg wall of living vine (CP 16): captures solids, drinks water and grows, burns easily (x3), brittle when frozen. A perfect guard (Catch & Sling) catches the projectile and slings it back.

moves.name: Lattice Roll
moves.desc: Guard flick up: the lattice rolls forward as a tumble-ball, entangling whoever it meets (0.8 s).

moves.name: Deep Roots
moves.desc: Guard flick down: root yourself (no knockback, pull or lift; anchor CP 35) and drink the puddles under you into the waterskin. Holds as long as you hold guard.

moves.name: Vinegrip
moves.desc: Hold: lash a vine to a body of up to 40 kg at 9 m (half the usual range falloff: it wins long contests); drag to aim, release to throw. Attack while holding: Wrap, the body roots whoever it hits. On a fighter: Hook, yank 3 m toward you (-20 balance).

moves.name: Vine Swing
moves.desc: Swing on a vine to an anchor (wall, pillar, ledge) within 9 m in the direction you push; with none in reach, a sidestep.

moves.name: Canopy
moves.desc: Hold evade: hang from a canopy of vines and hover 1.5 s, passing over ground attacks.

moves.name: Flare / Blaze / Fire Column / Inferno
moves.desc: Tap: a flare cone. Hold: the blaze (T1). Hold 1 s: Fire Column, a narrow 7 m jet that leaves a burning field. Hold 1.8 s: Inferno, a 9 m wide blaze and a 4 s field.

moves.name: Fireball / Twin / Great / Sunfall
moves.desc: A ball of flame (a body carrying 120 HU) that bursts 2 m on impact. Air can grip and feed it, water quenches it, vacuum snuffs it. Held: two, then a 240 HU ball bursting 3 m, then Sunfall: lobbed, it leaves a 4 m burning field.

moves.name: Fire Line / Double / Triple / Fire Ring
moves.desc: Flames race 12 m/s along the ground for 10 m, leaving a burning trail. Stopped by water and sand; ignites vines; warms stones it passes. Held: two lines, three lines, then a ring of fire around the rival.

moves.name: Fire Fan / Wide Fan / Wheel / Nova
moves.desc: A 120 degree sweep of flame at 3.5 m that clears vines and mist. Held: wider, then a full 360 degree Nova.

moves.name: Flame Guard / Heat Sink
moves.desc: A guard of heat. Perfect: absorbs a flame's heat into the reserve (Heat Sink); against a magma blob or hot rock it draws 300 HU out instantly (it crusts mid-air); ice melts before it lands; returns a bolt with Return Current.

moves.name: Backdraft
moves.desc: From the guard: release the whole heat reserve as a 5 m cone (H = reserve / 20, up to 25). Absorbed heat becomes the counter-attack.

moves.name: Ground Heat
moves.desc: From the guard: vent the heat reserve into the ground; it boils the puddles within 2 m and melts an ice floor. Your footing becomes lightning-safe.

moves.name: Thermal (HEAT / DRAW / VENT / SCORCH)
moves.desc: Hold on a stone: magma grip, melt it, release to pour a lava wave. On lava or hot rock: DRAW its heat into your reserve. On a wall or a body you can't grip: SCORCH its face at 300 HU/s (walls slump). Nothing in reach and heat in reserve: VENT.

moves.name: Rocket Hop
moves.desc: Hold evade: hop 2.5 m on flame and hover for 0.6 s (reach the high ledge, dodge ground lines).

moves.name: Blue Needle / Blue Lance / Searing Beam / White Core
moves.desc: A thin blue beam (5 m). Held: an 8 m lance, then the Searing Beam (10 m, 0.6 s: melts a flying stone into a falling magma blob), then White Core (12 m, 1 s: melts through a stone wall, fuses sand walls into glass).

moves.name: Comet Flame / Twin Comets / Great Comet / Piercing Comet
moves.desc: A compact blue fireball @26 m/s. It boils water shields fast and melts ice walls on contact. Held: faster and hotter; T3 pierces fighters.

moves.name: Blue Furrow / Deep Furrow / Lava Channel / Magma Rift
moves.desc: Melts the ground along a line: a lava channel (1 kg/m from the ground, melted with your heat) that burns what it runs over and can be pushed by Earth / Magma Surge. Held: deeper, then a 6 m wide 12 m rift.

moves.name: Corona
moves.desc: A blue ring around you (2.5 m, 1 s): it burns whoever is inside, melts incoming ice and small metal, burns vines. Held: wider and longer (3.5 m).

moves.name: Blue Aegis
moves.desc: A hot blue aura (CP 16, 12 Focus/s). Ice and metal of 8 kg or less melt before they land; stones arrive as hot rock; flames are absorbed into your reserve (x1.5 on a perfect guard).

moves.name: Flash Over
moves.desc: From the guard: the aura explodes outward (3 m, H 10, knock 6).

moves.name: Kiln
moves.desc: From the guard: superheat a stone, metal, sand or glass body within 2.5 m to 600 °C or more (sand fuses to glass). A trap: whoever seizes it next is burned.

moves.name: Smelter
moves.desc: Hold: ranged heat at 6 m without a grip, 450 HU/s (1.5x Scorch). Walls slump (their face melts into lava you can send back), metal melts, sand fuses to glass, ice boils to steam.

moves.name: Shimmer Step
moves.desc: 3 m in 0.12 s through a heat haze (7 i-frames).

moves.name: Afterburn
moves.desc: Hold evade: run at 7 m/s leaving burning blue footprints.

moves.name: Spark / Bolt / Storm Bolt / Skybreak
moves.desc: Tap: a 5 m spark to the nearest target or conductor (chains 2 m to wet fighters and metal). Hold 0.65 s: the Bolt (14 m, conducts). Hold 1.2 s: the Storm Bolt blasts through barriers it out-powers and forks. Hold 1.8 s: Skybreak strikes the target from above (walls don't matter) and its thunder deafens.

moves.name: Rail Arc
moves.desc: A straight 16 m arc that follows the conductors it crosses: through a water jet or stream still connected to its caster, through metal, through a charged body.

moves.name: Ground Current / Surge / Network / Storm Grid
moves.desc: A current races 20 m/s along conductive ground only (puddles, the pool's edge, the metal plate, caltrops, mud); it dies 2 m onto dry stone. Frozen puddles and ice floors stop it; Grounding is immune. T3 Storm Grid electrifies every connected conductive surface for 1.5 s.

moves.name: Arc Fan
moves.desc: Three forks of lightning, 6 m over 60 degrees; each one chains through what it strikes.

moves.name: Static Ward / Return Current
moves.desc: A crackling guard (CP 12). A bolt that hits it is half stored as static (up to 60), half taken; metal shots are deflected (x1.5). Perfect with Return Current: the bolt goes back at 80 %; perfect without it: fully absorbed.

moves.name: Static Burst
moves.desc: From the guard: release the stored static as a 4 m cone (E = stored, a 0.3 s shock). Empty: a weak shove.

moves.name: Grounding
moves.desc: From the guard: 1.5 s immune to conducted damage (ground currents pass you, conduction skips you); drains the charge of conductors you touch.

moves.name: Conductor's Hand / Arc Link
moves.desc: Hold on a conductor within 10 m (metal, a water body, a puddle, fog, caltrops, a rod or an embedded lance): it stores charge (E by hold tier; decays 4/s; touching it shocks). Release with aim: a bolt jumps you -> the charged body -> the nearest rival within 8 m of it. Bank it around cover.

moves.name: Arc Step
moves.desc: 6 m in 0.1 s as a streak of lightning (9 i-frames); the trail shocks whoever it crossed (E 6).

moves.name: Overcharge
moves.desc: Hold evade: +30 % move speed and faster recoveries (x0.8) - but any water that hits you shocks you.

moves.name: Pop / Burst / Blast / Detonation
moves.desc: Tap: a palm detonation (2 m, knock 6). Hold: a Burst 6 m ahead, a Blast at 9 m (r 3), then the Detonation at 12 m (r 4.5, 0.5 s fuse). Blasts shatter ice and glass, snuff flames, disperse clouds; vacuum suppresses them, mist halves them, wind fans them.

moves.name: Spark Mine
moves.desc: Throw an ember @14 m/s that sticks where it lands; it detonates when a rival comes within 1.5 m, on contact, or when you flick up again.

moves.name: Chain Blasts
moves.desc: Three detonations step along the ground every 0.15 s (P 10 each). Held: four, five, six.

moves.name: Scatter Charges
moves.desc: Four embers fanned out to 6 m; each pops after 0.4 s (P 8). Area denial.

moves.name: Reactive Blast
moves.desc: When hit, detonate outward (CP 18, 8 Focus per trigger): light solids are blown aside, flames snuffed (x1.5), clouds dispersed. Perfect: light solids are blasted back at the thrower.

moves.name: Shockwave
moves.desc: From the guard: a forward cone of blast (5 m, P 14): snuffs flames, shatters ice, pushes.

moves.name: Smother Blast
moves.desc: From the guard: a downward blast (P 10) that snuffs every fire field within 4 m and launches you 1.5 m up.

moves.name: Fuse
moves.desc: Hold: superheat a pocket of air at the aim point (10 m; steer it while holding, it grows with the hold). Release: it detonates there. In vapour x0.5, in a vacuum it fails, right after a vacuum well collapses x1.5; inside a tornado it makes a fire tornado.

moves.name: Blast Jump
moves.desc: A detonation at your feet launches you 4 m along the stick (straight up if neutral); it shoves whoever stands next to you.

moves.name: Afterglow
moves.desc: Hold evade: hover on small pops for 0.8 s.

moves.name: Palm Gust
moves.desc: A palm of wind: turns light shots and disperses clouds. Hold: Cyclone Push (legacy), then Gale (8 m, 50 deg) and Hurricane Palm (10 m, 60 deg) - strong enough to crust and stall a lava wave. Pressure 7 / 11 / 18 / 28 against what it meets.

moves.name: Wind Crescent
moves.desc: A crescent of cutting wind @22 m/s. Deflects the light shots it meets and cuts vines (x2). Hold: two crossing crescents, a 2 m wide one, then the Wind Scythe that pierces two targets.

moves.name: Dust Devil Line
moves.desc: A low line of wind races 14 m/s along the ground: trips (-30 balance), knocks up 3, raises dust (light blind). Hold: wider, stronger, longer.

moves.name: Crosswind
moves.desc: A lateral sweep of wind (120 deg, 5 m): shoves fighters sideways and curves the projectiles in flight by up to 40 deg - how far depends on how heavy and fast they are.

moves.name: Wall of Wind
moves.desc: From the guard: send the wind forward as a moving wall (8 m/s, 3 m wide, 6 m). Shoves fighters, turns light projectiles, carries clouds along.

moves.name: Downdraft
moves.desc: From the guard: a blast of wind driven down (r 3 m, P 12): slams airborne enemies to the ground (anti-flight), flattens fire fields, clears clouds.

moves.name: Updraft / Wind Grip
moves.desc: Context: a light body (<= 30 kg, fireballs too) in the aim cone within 9 m -> Wind Grip (seize it, drag-aim, release to fling; a gripped fireball grows 20 %). Otherwise Updraft: lift 2 m, keep holding to glide.

moves.name: Air Dash
moves.desc: A 4.6 m burst of wind with i-frames (legacy). Hold EVADE: Tailwind run.

moves.name: Tailwind
moves.desc: Hold EVADE: a wind at your back, x1.3 run speed while held (6 Focus/s).

moves.name: Twister / Tornado
moves.desc: A small vortex @12 m/s that lifts light targets and catches small shots it passes. Hold: twin twisters, then a Tornado (a zone that walks to the target for 4 s: it captures and orbits bodies up to 30 kg and lifts fighters) and the Cyclone Fortress (r 4 m, 6 s). Sand, fire, water or steam in it infuse it - the enemy's material turns it neutral.

moves.name: Spiral Lance
moves.desc: A drilling spiral of wind @24 m/s. Pierces mist, sand clouds and sand walls; stone and metal walls turn it. Hold: faster, stronger, pierces fighters.

moves.name: Dust Funnel
moves.desc: A ground vortex races 10 m/s: it gathers the loose bodies on its path and carries them to the target, where they are released as your attack - the arena's rubble becomes ammunition.

moves.name: Eddy Ring
moves.desc: A ring vortex (r 3 m) around you for 1.5 s: projectiles curve around you - orbit-deflected, sometimes straight back at the thrower - and light fighters are pushed out.

moves.name: Vortex Wall
moves.desc: A spinning barrier around you. It captures light projectiles - they orbit inside - instead of stopping them; heavier ones pass bent, flames are fed and spun. Perfect: Vortex Catch grabs even heavier shots and flings them faster. Flick up: Unleash. Flick down: Funnel Down. Weak to water mass and a Vacuum Well.

moves.name: Unleash
moves.desc: From the Vortex Wall: fling everything it captured at the target. Each body keeps its mass and heat and flies as YOUR attack (a new attack id); a perfectly caught shot flies 25 % faster.

moves.name: Funnel Down
moves.desc: From the Vortex Wall: drive the vortex into the ground - a dust crater - and drop the captured bodies at your feet, ready for Earth or Water to seize.

moves.name: Eye of the Storm
moves.desc: Create a tornado at the aim point (10 m) and steer it by dragging the aim while you hold; release and it lives 2 s more. Over an enemy tornado: a contest - strong enough, you take it over (and steer it); merged with your own it grows. Hold longer: bigger, stronger.

moves.name: Spin Step
moves.desc: A spinning sidestep (3 m, 10 i-frames) that turns light projectiles aside while you spin.

moves.name: Whirl Lift
moves.desc: Hold EVADE: hover 1.5 m in a small vortex of your own (8 Focus/s). Ground lines pass under you; projectiles curve around the vortex.

moves.name: Pressure Palm / Air Cannon / Implode / Collapse
moves.desc: A point-blank burst of pressure (knock 8, -30 balance). Hold: a 12 m pressure bullet (Air Cannon), then Implode - a vacuum point 8 m ahead that pulls 3 m for 0.4 s and collapses - and Collapse (r 4 m, crush -60 balance). Flames inside a vacuum die; sound inside dies.

moves.name: Suction Line
moves.desc: A suction beam (10 m): pulls the fighter it meets 2 m toward you - or pulls YOU to a wall or anchor. Light projectiles (<= 12 kg) it meets are yanked into your hand.

moves.name: Pressure Mine
moves.desc: A pressure trap (r 1.2 m, 10 s) buried 2 m ahead. A fighter who steps on it is blown 7 m up. Hold: stronger.

moves.name: Vacuum Arc
moves.desc: A near-vacuum crescent (100 deg, 4 m): snuffs the flames in the arc (x2), silences sound, and pulls what it meets a little toward you.

moves.name: Null Bubble
moves.desc: A vacuum shell around you (r 1.8 m, CP 14): fire and combustion die in it (x2), sound is nullified (x3), mist and steam collapse into water, lightning with E <= 1.5 x CP is blocked (a stronger bolt is weakened). Solids and liquids simply pass. Perfect: Vacuum Catch - a light projectile is caught and spat back. Flick up: Pressure Wave. Flick down: Anchor. Weak to a gale that fills it (x1.2).

moves.name: Pressure Wave
moves.desc: From the Null Bubble: the bubble collapses outward as a ring (r 3 m, P 16): shoves everything near you back.

moves.name: Anchor
moves.desc: From the Null Bubble: a low-pressure anchor while held (CP 35): immune to knockback, pulls and tornado lift. You barely move (x0.3).

moves.name: Vacuum Well
moves.desc: A suction zone at the aim point (9 m, r 3 m) while you hold: it pulls projectiles out of the air (they hang in the well), pulls and compresses clouds (steam -> water, sand -> sandstone), drags fighters (-40 % moving away) and puts fire out. Release: it collapses - what it held is crushed and the air rushes in (a combustion there x1.5). Hold longer: stronger, wider.

moves.name: Pressure Hop
moves.desc: A leap 3 m up and forward (9 i-frames) on a cushion of low pressure: a float landing without landing lag.

moves.name: Slipstream
moves.desc: Hold EVADE: x1.3 speed in a low-pressure wake; projectiles behind you are slowed (6 Focus/s).

moves.name: Clap / Shout / Roar / Resonance
moves.desc: A cone of sound: Clap (3 m, 60 deg, daze) -> Shout (7 m) -> Roar (10 m: shatters ice, glass and thin walls, rains out mist, -8 Focus) -> Resonance (12 m: shatters any brittle body, deafens 2 s). Disrupts charges and channels when its pressure reaches their cohesion (6 + 4 x tier). Sand, fog and vines absorb it; stone and metal walls throw it back; a vacuum nullifies it; it passes through water.

moves.name: Sound Lance
moves.desc: A focused pulse (14 m, a visible ring): passes through water and mist, reflects off stone and metal walls and the arena walls - bank it around cover. Hold: stronger and longer.

moves.name: Tremor Hum
moves.desc: A ground hum races 18 m/s for 10 m: knocks fighters over (-35 balance), cracks the walls it passes, and pops loose stones into the air where they can be seized from range.

moves.name: Echo Ring
moves.desc: A ring of sound (r 4 m) all around you: reveals everyone hiding (fog, Mist Step, Fog Walk, burrowers) and interrupts the channels and charges its pressure reaches.

moves.name: Sound Barrier
moves.desc: A vibrating front (CP 12): ice and glass shatter against it (x2.5), light solids are turned, sound is cancelled. Perfect: Echo Return throws incoming sound back at its source. A vacuum nullifies it, sand absorbs it, heavy solids ignore it. Flick up: Thunder Step. Flick down: Ground Ping.

moves.name: Thunder Step
moves.desc: From the guard: a 4 m boom-dash forward that shoves everything in front of you (P 14).

moves.name: Ground Ping
moves.desc: From the guard: a pulse through the ground (r 6 m, strength by guard hold): reveals burrowers and disrupts the ground lines whose power it matches - spike lines, currents, roots, sand surges.

moves.name: Flight
moves.desc: Rise to 2.2 m and fly at 6 m/s with every attack still usable (6 Focus + 10/s). Press again to glide down. Airborne: ground lines, quicksand and ice floors do nothing to you; gusts and tornadoes blow you around (x1.5 balance) and a lightning bolt has no ground to run to.

moves.name: Boom Step
moves.desc: A 6 m supersonic dash (9 i-frames) that ends in a boom: knock 3 on everyone within 2 m.

moves.name: Hover
moves.desc: Hold EVADE: hold your height in the air (6 Focus/s). Ground lines pass under you.
